data.title: 椎叶紬 · 魔法记事本
data.description: 紬把今天遇到的事记进本子，末尾画了一颗小星星。墨迹还没干，她小心地捏着纸页一角。
data.action: 墨迹还没干，她小心地捏着纸页一角
data.promptProse: Seated at her wooden desk in the evening wearing her white witch hat and cape, Tsumugi leans softly over a small open notebook after finishing the day's entry with a tiny hand-drawn star. Holding her pen paused in one hand, she delicately pinches the bottom corner of the page with her other fingertips to keep her sleeve away from the glistening fresh ink. Warm desk lamplight glows across the paper grain, ink bottle, and her focused expression.
data.animaCaption: Leaning over her wooden desk in her white witch cape, Tsumugi pauses with pen in hand and carefully pinches the page corner clear of the fresh ink in her small notebook. Warm desk lamplight illuminates her focused gaze and the handwritten star.
